subject: BlueRidge CAIQ: sandbox access & evidence proofing request
messages:
From: Emma Graham <emma.graham@blueridge.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>; Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Carlos Vega <carlos.vega@auditservices.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ intake & small proofing request

Hi Kimberly / Ben,

Thanks again for taking our CAIQ. BlueRidge has a compressed timeline for the cloud assurance intake: our auditors (Carlos copied) want to validate a subset of controls related to logging, key management, and network segmentation next week. We've attached the CAIQ spreadsheet with our annotations for the sections we expect to test.

Two asks: 
- Can Redwood provide a short-lived sandbox or read-only environment where auditors can fetch example logs (obfuscated) and see the KMS key metadata?
- Can you confirm a point person who will own the responses and evidence for controls CCM-01 (logging), CCM-03 (encryption), and CCM-09 (network)?

We appreciate a quick turnaround — auditors will start the validation window on 2027-05-24.

Best,
Emma Graham
Director, Security Assurance
BlueRidge Financial

Attachments: CAIQ_Questionnaire_BLUERIDGE_v1.xlsx

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Graham <emma.graham@blueridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ intake & small proofing request

Emma — thanks for the clear asks and timeline. We're able to support the validation window. Quick notes and next steps: 

- Sandbox access: We can stand up a short-lived read-only environment (temporary credentials + S3 pre-signed listing) for the auditors. That will include obfuscated logs (PII removed) and KMS key metadata (no key material).
- Owners: I'll be the lead for CCM-01 (logging) and CCM-09 (network) evidence. Priyom will own CCM-03 (encryption/KMS) and will coordinate with our infra team for key rotation history.
- Evidence package: we'll prepare a draft PDF of the responses and include exports from our logging pipeline. Ben, can you generate the S3 audit export and a sample CloudTrail slice? Priyom, can you assemble KMS metadata and rotation proof?

I will also create a short access policy for the auditors (read-only, IP-restricted) and share a Drive link. Expect the first draft by EOD 2027-05-18.

Kimberly Park
Head of Security Compliance
Redwood Inference

On Mon, May 17, 2027 at 09:12 AM Emma Graham <emma.graham@blueridge.com> wrote:

>

Attachments referenced: none in this reply

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Emma Graham <emma.graham@blueridge.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ intake & small proofing request

Kimberly / Priyom — I pulled the audit slice and prepared the export. Notes:
- redwood_s3_audit_export_202704.zip contains a 7-day window of S3 object-level events (object names obfuscated) and an execution log from our ingestion lambda.
- I included a short README in the zip that maps object IDs to control evidence references (CCM-01-1, CCM-01-2 etc.).
- Access to the temporary sandbox will be IP-restricted to BlueRidge auditors; Carlos, please confirm the external IPs you will use.

Attaching the draft evidence bundle and the export stub for internal review. I'll upload the full zip to the shared Drive once Kimberly signs off on the access policy.

Ben Carter
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_s3_audit_export_202704.zip, response_draft_v1.pdf

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Graham <emma.graham@blueridge.com>, Carlos Vega <carlos.vega@auditservices.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ intake & small proofing request

Emma / Carlos — quick confirmation from the encryption side: 

- KMS metadata export (no key material) is attached and includes creation dates, key rotation boolean flags, and envelope encryption usage examples. See file: CAIQ_kms_metadata_20270518.csv (attached to internal bundle).
- We've annotated the CAIQ rows for CCM-03 with pointer IDs that match Ben's README (e.g., CCM-03-A -> KMS-2021-rot-01).
- Sandbox credentials will be valid 2027-05-24 09:00 - 2027-05-28 17:00 PT and will be rotated after the audit window.

Carlos — please send the auditor IPs and we will finalize the IP allowlist and share the pre-signed S3 listings.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Infrastructure Security Lead, Redwood Inference
